name: Emission UV Texture Map Optimization
definition: An optimization procedure to recover an emission UV texture map for a scene mesh by minimizing the rendering loss between ground-truth HDR images and rendered images, using L1 regularization and adaptive clipping/boosting to encourage sparsity and accelerate convergence.
summary: Emission UV Texture Map Optimization recovers emission maps via inverse rendering with L1 regularization, supporting indirect lighting optimization unlike differentiable rasterization.
